0 · Master diagram

The whole system on one canvas. Hand-laid SVG, so it renders with no network and no JavaScript. The server never looks inside a page: a page's canvas is one JSON string built and parsed by editor.js. notes.db and notes.db-wal are drawn as two boxes because together they are the database (P8). Dashed = not built. The server binds 127.0.0.1:3000 with no auth, purges pages trashed more than 60 days ago (at startup and every 6 h), and stores pages.content as an opaque string.

7.1 High-level design: context, containers, deployment

Context

flowchart LR
  OWNER(["Owner<br/>(only user)"])
  BROWSER["Browser tab<br/>Chrome / Edge"]
  APP["OneNote Clone<br/>node server/index.js"]
  DISK[("Local disk<br/>data/")]
  SPEECH["Browser speech service<br/>(Dictate only)"]
  OWNER -->|"types, draws, clicks"| BROWSER
  BROWSER <-->|"HTTP JSON on 127.0.0.1:3000"| APP
  APP <-->|"SQLite + files"| DISK
  BROWSER -.->|"audio, only while Dictate is on"| SPEECH

Why: the only external dependency at runtime is optional. Dictation uses the browser's built-in Web Speech API, which in Chrome sends audio to Google's speech service. Everything else works offline. No CDN, no account, no sync service. See ../1_build-plan.md §1.

Containers

flowchart TB
  subgraph TAB["Browser tab"]
    FE["Frontend<br/>public/index.html + js/*.js<br/>ES modules, no build"]
    LS[("localStorage<br/>oc.* prefs")]
    FE --- LS
  end
  subgraph PROC["Node process (one)"]
    EXP["Express 5 app<br/>server/index.js"]
    SQL["node:sqlite<br/>DatabaseSync, WAL"]
    EXP --> SQL
  end
  subgraph DATA["DATA_DIR (default ./data)"]
    DB[("notes.db")]
    WAL[("notes.db-wal<br/>notes.db-shm")]
    UP[("uploads/<br/>uuid.ext")]
  end
  FE -->|"GET /, /js, /css (static)"| EXP
  FE -->|"/api/* JSON"| EXP
  FE -->|"GET /uploads/*"| EXP
  SQL --> DB
  SQL --> WAL
  EXP -->|"fs.writeFileSync"| UP
  BK["npm run backup<br/>scripts/backup.mjs"] -.->|"read-only VACUUM INTO"| DB
  TEST["npm test<br/>tests/*.test.mjs"] -.->|"spawns its own server<br/>(free port, temp DATA_DIR)"| EXP
  TEST -.->|"drives installed Chrome<br/>via playwright-core"| FE

Why tests start their own server: each suite gets a fresh database in the OS temp folder and a free port, so npm test can run while the real server is up on 3000, and never touches data/.

Why: one process owns the database, so there is no locking story to tell. notes.db and notes.db-wal are drawn separately on purpose. Together they are the database, and on a small notebook the WAL can hold everything (P8). The backup script is a separate short-lived process that opens the DB read-only.

Deployment

flowchart LR
  subgraph PC["Owner's Windows 10 PC"]
    CH["Chrome"]
    N["node server/index.js<br/>127.0.0.1:3000"]
    F[("D:/CODING/.../27_OneNoteClone/data")]
    CH -->|"loopback"| N --> F
  end
  PHONE["Phone / second device"]
  PROXY["Reverse proxy or Tailscale<br/>+ auth"]
  PHONE -.->|"PLANNED · OD4"| PROXY -.->|"PLANNED"| N
  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5
  class PHONE,PROXY planned

Why: bound to 127.0.0.1 because there is no authentication. The dashed path is not built. It needs OD4 (how to protect it) and OD3 (two devices editing one page) settled first.

7.2 Low-level design: components and classes

Frontend components

flowchart TB
  IDX["index.html<br/>static shell: ribbon panels,<br/>rail, side views, canvas"]
  APP["app.js<br/>state, navigation, CRUD,<br/>ribbon commands, shortcuts"]
  ED["editor.js<br/>PageEditor (one instance)"]
  UI["ui.js<br/>h(), showMenu, modal,<br/>toast, formatters"]
  IC["icons.js<br/>svg(), hydrateIcons()"]
  API["api.js<br/>get/post/patch/put/del, upload"]
  TODO["todo.js<br/>TodoView: planner pages,<br/>parseQuickAdd()"]
  TPL["templates.js<br/>TEMPLATES[].build()"]
  IDX -->|"type=module"| APP
  APP -->|"new PageEditor()"| ED
  ED -->|"kind === 'todo':<br/>mount / serialize"| TODO
  TODO -->|"onChange → scheduleSave()"| ED
  APP -->|"addPage({template})"| TPL
  TPL -->|"emptyTodo()"| TODO
  APP -->|"method calls: load, exec,<br/>toggleTag, setMode, flush …"| ED
  ED -->|"events: status, saved, title,<br/>selection, mode, painter, dictation"| APP
  APP --> UI
  ED --> UI
  APP --> IC
  UI --> IC
  APP --> API
  ED -->|"PATCH page, upload"| API

Why todo.js hangs off the editor, not app.js: a planner is still a page. It is loaded, autosaved (same 600 ms debounce, same no-op snapshot check), searched and exported through PageEditor. Only the rendering and the meaning of content differ, so the editor references this.kind 17 times (grep, 2026-10-15) to delegate or refuse. app.js checks editor.kind once, to refuse "New note container" on a planner. Everything else in it is kind-agnostic.

Why: PageEditor knows one page and nothing about notebooks or sections. app.js never touches the canvas DOM directly. It calls editor methods and listens to editor events (an EventTarget). That boundary is where page-level customizations go (in editor.js) versus organisation-level ones (in app.js).

Server components

flowchart LR
  REQ(["HTTP request"]) --> MW["json parser<br/>25 MB; 500 MB for /import"]
  MW --> STATIC["express.static<br/>public/, /uploads (nosniff,<br/>attachment for non-media)"]
  MW --> ROUTES["/api routes"]
  ROUTES --> NB["notebooks<br/>+ /tree"]
  ROUTES --> SE["sections"]
  ROUTES --> PG["pages<br/>+ restore"]
  ROUTES --> MISC["trash · reorder · search ·<br/>recent · settings · uploads ·<br/>export · import"]
  NB & SE & PG & MISC --> H["helpers: one/all/run,<br/>insert/update, nextSort, tx"]
  H --> DB[("node:sqlite")]
  ROUTES --> E404["/api 404 → {error:'Not found'}"]
  ROUTES --> EH["error handler → {error}<br/>500 hides details"]

Why: routes are thin and synchronous. DatabaseSync means no await between reading and writing, so a handler's statements cannot interleave with another request's. Multi-statement writes (seed, create notebook, insert page after, reorder, import) are wrapped in tx().

  class TodoView {
    +data : TodoContent|null

  EventTarget <|-- PageEditor
  PageEditor --> "2" Tool
  PageEditor --> "*" Stroke
  PageEditor --> "1" TodoView

Why TodoView re-renders whole: a planner is at most a few hundred rows, so rebuilding the list on each structural change is cheaper to reason about than patching it. Two exceptions avoid lost input. Typing in the eyebrow, description or a month note updates data without re-rendering. Finishing an inline task edit swaps the input back for a span instead of re-rendering, so a blur caused by clicking another control can't replace that control before its click lands.

Why lastRange: clicking a ribbon control (or typing in the font-size box) moves focus out of the page, and the selection with it. Every command starts with restoreSelection(), which puts back the last range seen inside a container. Ribbon buttons also preventDefault() on mousedown so focus usually never leaves.

7.3 Data model

Tables

erDiagram
  NOTEBOOKS ||--o{ SECTIONS : "ON DELETE CASCADE"
  SECTIONS ||--o{ PAGES : "ON DELETE CASCADE"
  NOTEBOOKS {
    TEXT id PK "UUID"
    TEXT name
    TEXT color "#rrggbb"
    INTEGER sort
    INTEGER created_at "ms epoch"
    INTEGER updated_at "ms epoch"
  }
  SECTIONS {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT notebook_id FK
    TEXT name
    TEXT color
    INTEGER sort
    INTEGER created_at
    INTEGER updated_at
  }
  PAGES {
    TEXT id PK
    TEXT section_id FK
    TEXT title
    TEXT content "JSON string, opaque to server"
    TEXT text "derived plain text, for search"
    INTEGER level "0..2 subpage depth"
    INTEGER sort
    INTEGER created_at
    INTEGER updated_at "title/content changes only"
    INTEGER deleted_at "NULL = live"
  }
  SETTINGS {
    TEXT key PK
    TEXT value "JSON"
  }

Indexes: sections(notebook_id, sort), pages(section_id, sort), pages(updated_at). Schema version 1 (PRAGMA user_version), created by server/db.js.

Why text exists: search must not match HTML tags, attribute values or ink coordinates inside content. The browser already has the rendered text, so it sends it with every save. This is also the column's weakness: the server cannot recompute it (decisions 2026-10-14, contract obligation 1).

Why no blocks table: a page is always loaded and saved whole, so per-container rows would only add joins and a diff step (decisions 2026-10-14).

    +lines : "none"|"narrow"|"college"|"grid-small"|"grid-large"

What crosses the wire: pages.content for a planner (since 2026-10-15)

classDiagram
  class TodoContent {
    +v : 1
    +type : "todo"
    +eyebrow : string
    +subtitle : string
    +months : Month[]
    +tasks : Task[]
  }
  class Month {
    +key : "YYYY-MM"
    +note : string
    +sub : string "replaces the date range when set"
  }
  class Task {
    +id : string
    +text : string
    +done : boolean
    +doneAt : number|null
    +tag : string|null
    +month : "YYYY-MM"|null "null = Unscheduled"
    +date : "YYYY-MM-DD"|null "must lie inside month"
    +created : number
  }
  TodoContent --> "*" Month
  TodoContent --> "*" Task
  Task ..> Month : month key

Why month and date are separate: the owner plans by month and dates only some tasks. A date always wins: setting one sets month to match, and normalizeTodo() enforces it on load. The Month/Date/Tag choice is deliberately not here. It lives in localStorage so switching views never saves the page (decisions 2026-10-15).

Inside Block.html, tags are attributes on paragraph elements: <div data-tag="todo" data-checked="true">…</div>. Images are <img src="/uploads/<uuid>.png">. Attachments are <a class="attachment" contenteditable="false" href="/uploads/…">.

Why points, not SVG path strings, in Stroke.p: the eraser does a distance-to-segment test. Path strings would force hit-testing rendered SVG, which barely hits 1–2 px lines (decisions 2026-10-14).

7.4 Sequences

Typing → durable

sequenceDiagram
  actor U as Owner
  participant C as .nb-content
  participant E as PageEditor
  participant A as app.js
  participant S as server/index.js
  participant D as SQLite (WAL)
  U->>C: keystroke
  C->>E: input event
  E->>E: fixFontSizes(), scheduleSave()
  E-->>A: status 'dirty' → "Saving…"
  Note over E: 600 ms with no further input
  E->>E: save(): snapshot === savedSnapshot?
  alt unchanged
    E-->>A: status 'saved' (no request)
  else changed
    E->>S: PATCH /api/pages/:id {title, content, text}
    S->>D: UPDATE pages … updated_at = now
    D-->>S: ok
    S-->>E: 200 page list form
    E-->>A: saved(res), status 'saved'
    A->>A: update page list (re-sort if by modified/title)
  end

Why the snapshot check: without it, clicking and leaving an empty container saves and bumps updated_at. Measured: 0 requests with the check, 1 with it removed (2026-10-15).

Server down during an edit

sequenceDiagram
  participant E as PageEditor
  participant A as app.js
  participant S as server
  E->>S: PATCH (server down)
  S--xE: network error
  E-->>A: status 'error'
  A->>A: first error since 'saved'? → one toast (P7)
  loop every 4 s
    E->>S: PATCH
    S--xE: network error
    E-->>A: 'saving' → 'error' (no new toast)
  end
  Note over S: server restarted
  E->>S: PATCH
  S-->>E: 200
  E-->>A: 'saved' → "All changes saved", toast flag reset

Opening a page from a link, Back, or a search result

sequenceDiagram
  participant B as Browser history
  participant A as app.js
  participant E as PageEditor
  participant S as server
  B->>A: popstate (#/page/:id) or navigateToPage(id)
  A->>A: editor.page.id === id? → stop
  A->>E: flush() (finish pending save of current page)
  A->>S: GET /api/pages/:id
  alt 404
    S-->>A: {error:'Page not found'} → toast, stay on current page
  else deleted_at not null
    S-->>A: page → toast "in Deleted pages", stay
  else live page
    S-->>A: page (with notebook_id)
    opt different notebook, or page not in loaded tree
      A->>S: GET /api/notebooks/:nb/tree
      S-->>A: {notebook, sections, pages}
    end
    A->>A: renderSections(), renderPages()
    A->>E: load(page)
  end

Why openSeq: each open increments a counter and drops its result if a newer open started meanwhile, so fast clicking through pages can't load an older page last.

New page from a template, then adding a planner task

sequenceDiagram
  actor U as Owner
  participant A as app.js
  participant T as templates.js
  participant S as server
  participant E as PageEditor
  participant V as TodoView
  U->>A: Add page ▾ → To-do planner
  A->>E: flush()
  A->>T: build(new Date())
  T-->>A: {title, content: JSON string, text}
  A->>S: POST /api/pages {section_id, title, content, text}
  S-->>A: 201 page
  A->>S: GET /api/notebooks/:nb/tree
  A->>S: GET /api/pages/:id
  A->>E: load(page)
  E->>E: content.type === 'todo' → kind = 'todo'
  E->>V: mount(inner, head, data, pageId)
  U->>V: types "Sign offer #Sabre @20 Oct" + Enter
  V->>V: parseQuickAdd() → {text, tag, date}
  V->>V: change(): month = date's month, render()
  V->>E: onChange() → scheduleSave()
  Note over E,S: same 600 ms autosave as a canvas page

Why one POST with the content: the page never exists empty, and its text is searchable at once (tested: milestones finds a fresh Project plan with no edits).

Inserting a picture

sequenceDiagram
  actor U as Owner
  participant A as app.js
  participant E as PageEditor
  participant S as server
  participant F as data/uploads
  U->>A: Insert → Picture
  A->>E: ensureCaret() (restore selection or create a container)
  A->>U: file picker
  U->>E: chooses file(s)
  E->>S: POST /api/uploads (octet-stream, X-Filename)
  S->>F: write <uuid>.<ext>
  S-->>E: {url, name, size}
  E->>E: restoreSelection(), insertHTML('<img data-new …>')
  E->>E: strip style + data-new from new <img> (P3)
  E->>E: scheduleSave()

Why octet-stream: a JSON file sent as application/json would be eaten by the global JSON parser (400 Empty upload, observed 2026-10-15).

7.5 State machines

Save status (the title-bar indicator)

Values are the strings PageEditor emits as status events.

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> saved : load(page)
  saved --> dirty : scheduleSave()
  dirty --> dirty : more input (timer restarts)
  dirty --> saving : timer fired, snapshot changed
  dirty --> saved : timer fired, snapshot unchanged
  saving --> saved : 200 and no timer pending
  saving --> dirty : input while in flight (scheduleSave)
  saving --> error : network error / 5xx
  error --> saving : retry after 4 s
  error --> dirty : user keeps typing (scheduleSave)

Why it matters: the toast fires on the first error after a saved, not on every entry into error. Each retry passes through saving → error, and the earlier version toasted every time (P7).

Page lifecycle

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> live : POST /api/pages (or new section / notebook)
  live --> trashed : DELETE /api/pages/{id} → deleted_at = now
  trashed --> live : POST /restore → deleted_at = NULL
  trashed --> [*] : DELETE ?permanent=1, DELETE /api/trash, or purge after 60 days
  live --> [*] : section or notebook deleted (cascade)
  trashed --> [*] : section or notebook deleted (cascade)

Why the cascade edges matter: deleting a section also destroys its trashed pages. The trash does not protect them (contract obligation 6).

Editor tool mode

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> type
  type --> pen : modePen
  type --> hl : modeHl
  type --> eraser : modeEraser
  pen --> hl : modeHl
  hl --> pen : modePen
  pen --> eraser : modeEraser
  hl --> eraser : modeEraser
  eraser --> pen : modePen
  eraser --> hl : modeHl
  pen --> type : Esc / modeType / load(page)
  hl --> type : Esc / modeType / load(page)
  eraser --> type : Esc / modeType / load(page)

In any mode other than type, the ink SVG takes pointer events (class draw on #pageInner), so containers cannot be clicked. Opening another page always returns to type. A pen's eraser end (pointerdown with button === 5) erases even in pen mode.

7.6 Activity: where the logic branches

save(): save or skip

flowchart TD
  S(["save(opts)"]) --> T["clear timer"]
  T --> IF{"inflight?"}
  IF -->|yes| W["await inflight"] --> P
  IF -->|no| P{"this.page?"}
  P -->|null| X(["return"])
  P -->|set| SN["snap = snapshot()"]
  SN --> EQ{"snap === savedSnapshot?"}
  EQ -->|yes| OK1["dirty = false<br/>status 'saved'"] --> X
  EQ -->|no| REQ["status 'saving'<br/>PATCH /api/pages/:id"]
  REQ --> R{"response"}
  R -->|"200"| SAME{"this.page === page?"}
  SAME -->|yes| SV["savedSnapshot = snap"] --> NT{"timer set?<br/>(edited meanwhile)"}
  NT -->|no| OK2["dirty = false<br/>status 'saved'"]
  NT -->|yes| KEEP["stay dirty"]
  SAME -->|no| EV
  OK2 --> EV["emit 'saved'"]
  KEEP --> EV
  R -->|"throws"| ER["status 'error'"] --> SP{"still same page?"}
  SP -->|yes| RT["dirty = true<br/>retry in 4000 ms"]
  SP -->|no| X

Mouse down on the canvas

flowchart TD
  M(["mousedown on #pageInner"]) --> B{"button === 0?"}
  B -->|no| N(["ignore"])
  B -->|yes| MD{"mode === 'type'?"}
  MD -->|no| INK(["ink layer handles it:<br/>draw or erase"])
  MD -->|yes| TG{"target === #pageInner?<br/>(empty canvas, not a container)"}
  TG -->|no| N2(["browser default:<br/>caret / selection in container"])
  TG -->|yes| PG{"page loaded?"}
  PG -->|no| N
  PG -->|yes| NEW["addBlock at (x − 8, y − 10) ÷ zoom<br/>min y 12, focusBlock()"]
  NEW --> BLUR{"later: focus leaves block<br/>and isEmptyBlock()?"}
  BLUR -->|yes| RM["remove block, scheduleSave()<br/>(save skips: snapshot unchanged)"]
  BLUR -->|no| KEEP(["block stays"])

Why the focus check ignores the ribbon: clicking the font-size box moves focus out of the container. The focusout handler skips removal when focus went to .ribbon, .menu or a modal, so a fresh empty container survives choosing its formatting first.

Where a new planner task lands

flowchart TD
  IN(["Enter in an add box<br/>of group g"]) --> P["parseQuickAdd(raw, {defaultMonth: g.month})"]
  P --> TXT{"text left after<br/>removing #tag / @date?"}
  TXT -->|no| T0(["toast: type the task itself"])
  TXT -->|yes| TAG["tag = parsed.tag ?? g.tag ?? null"]
  TAG --> D{"parsed.date?"}
  D -->|yes| D1["date = parsed.date<br/>month = date's month"]
  D -->|no| D2["date = g.date ?? null<br/>month = date's month, else g.month ?? null"]
  D1 --> ADD["push task, ensure its month exists,<br/>render, scheduleSave()"]
  D2 --> ADD
  ADD --> MOV{"Month view and<br/>month ≠ g.month?"}
  MOV -->|yes| TO(["toast: Added to November (20 Nov)"])
  MOV -->|no| DONE(["focus stays in the same add box"])

Group kinds that set defaults: a month group (g.month), a date group (g.date, g.month), a tag group (g.tag), "No date" / "No tag" / "Unscheduled" (nothing), and the top add box in Date and Tag views (nothing). The Overdue group has no add box.

Paste into a container

flowchart TD
  P(["paste event in .nb-content"]) --> F{"clipboardData.files?"}
  F -->|"1+ files"| UP["preventDefault<br/>insertFiles(): upload each,<br/>img for image/*, attachment otherwise"]
  F -->|none| H{"text/html present?"}
  H -->|no| DEF(["browser default:<br/>plain text"])
  H -->|yes| OWN{"types include<br/>application/x-onenote-clone?"}
  OWN -->|yes| S1["sanitizeHtml(html, own = true)<br/>keep style, class, data-*"]
  OWN -->|no| S2["sanitizeHtml(html, own = false)<br/>keep only weight/style/decoration/align"]
  S1 --> INS["insertHTML"]
  S2 --> INS

Both sanitiser paths drop <script>, <style>, <iframe>, forms, all on* attributes, non-http(s) links, and any <img> left without a src (P4).
